tasks.description: Decompose the goal of analyzing user preferences into smaller sub-tasks.
subtask_goals: Identify key aspects to consider in analyzing user preferences, such as past purchases, browsing history, ratings given, and expressed interests.
For each aspect, determine what data needs to be collected or analyzed to understand the user's preferences.

outputs.description: List of aspects to consider when analyzing user preferences
Data requirements for each aspect identified in user preference analysis.
